commitment_proxy: First pickup of a raw own-side ingredient, action index starting at zero. Earlier navigation commitment is not identified.
hidden_reveal_proxy: First pickup of a raw ingredient by L0; hidden from L1 in this reconstruction.
visible_cue: First post-action state with any left-side ingredient visible to L1. The next decision can use this cue. This is not the paper's specified visibility mask; that mask is unpublished.
waiting_candidate: First raw pickup after visible cue, plus >=3 consecutive pre-pickup/pre-cue transitions with ego state unchanged, and >=3 excess actions over the closest available raw pickup. Descriptive candidate only, not proof of information-seeking.
nearest: Shortest action count from initial position/orientation to a raw-ingredient pickup, including interact; all ties qualify.
selection: All 16 previously passing policies, all 3000 saved evaluation episodes each; no filtering for success.
